data.one_liner: Bridges OpenCC to Flutter for converting Simplified/Traditional Chinese text.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to convert Chinese text between Simplified and Traditional forms with regional standards. Supports Android, iOS, and Web, with optional background processing and web‑specific fallback handling.
use_when: You need offline or on‑device Chinese script conversion
You target multiple platforms (mobile and web) and want a single API
You want to process large texts without blocking the UI
avoid_when: You require full translation or language understanding
You need idiom conversion on web without fallback
strengths: Multiple conversion options covering regional standards
Background thread support for large inputs
Works on Android, iOS, and Web with automatic CDN loading
weaknesses: Web implementation lacks some idiom options (e.g., TW2Sp)
First web conversion requires internet to load the CDN library
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml; for web you may optionally preload the opencc-js script in index.html.
